propositions: A new plan-review criterion ac-process-gate must be added to CANONICAL_LLM, absent from CODEBASE_GROUNDED and AGENT_TIER, resolving to 1-TURN execution tier.

The ac-process-gate criterion must fire (advisory posture) on acceptance criteria whose entire completion predicate is a generic mechanical process gate (children-closed, tests/CI pass, plan-review passes, commit-trailer/DCO present) indistinguishable across unrelated tickets.

The ac-process-gate criterion must pass (no finding) on acceptance criteria naming or turning on ticket-specific deliverables (e.g., E2E tests for a named feature, plan-review rubric update), even when tests or CI are involved.

The routing entry in criteria_routing.json must declare ac-process-gate with exec=1-TURN, default_posture=advisory, facet=ac-text-quality, and applies_at.scope=["container","leaf"] with a two-key checklist (not-applicable gate and judgment key).

The rubric prompt file plan_review_ac_process_gate.md must document the advisory posture, enumerate the reject-set and accept-set, state the "reads identically on arbitrary unrelated ticket" litmus, and reference docs/plan-review-gate.md.

Live bounded-sanity evaluation must confirm recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, kappa=1.0 with process-gate ACs firing and deliverable ACs passing, committed to docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/ac_process_gate_sanity.json.
